- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided strategies for conflict resolution and forgiveness, including:
  - Acknowledge and accept your feelings.
  - Identify the root cause of the conflict.
  - Practice empathy.
  - Let go of the need for justice.
  - Use the "3 Rs" of forgiveness: Recognize, Release, Reframe.
  - Seek support from trusted individuals.
  - Practice self-care.
  - Consider a "letter of forgiveness" exercise.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended resources for forgiveness:
  - Books: "The Forgiveness Project" by Marina Cantacuzino, "Forgive for Good" by Dr. Frederic Luskin, "The Art of Forgiveness, Lovingkindness, and Peace" by Jack Kornfield.
  - Online resources: The Forgiveness Project (theforgivenessproject.com), Greater Good Magazine (greatergood.berkeley.edu), Mindful.org (mindful.org).
